items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that the composite of cocontinuous functors is cocontinuous and that the associated morphism of topoi is the composite of the associated morphisms (statement lines 4680-4692). The proof is a complete argument: cocontinuity is proved by refining a covering twice, once in the intermediate and once in the source site, so that the image of the resulting covering refines the given one (proof lines 4695-4702); and the identification of the morphisms of topoi is reduced to the corresponding identity of functors on presheaves, which is immediate from the definitions (proof lines 4703-4708). The non-formal content is the double refinement. The claim is H2: two written-out steps with each input named.
